title: Conditional κ = 0.001652704716932828: joint-call owners beyond PR649
body:
## Result

Conditional **κ = 0.001652704716932828**, improving the pinned PR649 result 0.001652528731617094 by **0.0106494557%**. Conservative κ = 0.001652704714052949.

This changes the whole-helper owner assignment on PR649's dissolved Gauge44 map. It retains PR645's local word, widths, 72-call schedule, controller and physical interfaces, and the same reviewed PR589 bit supplier used by PR649. Exact complex saving is `1655440671539283540487 / 10^24`; bit saving remains `1733427039589844234749 / 10^24`.

## What changes

A bounded joint-call search releases two calls together and accepts only exact integer majorization improvements. One pass over 120 nominated pairs accepted 22 moves. The frozen map has **260,960 paid children**, 26 fewer than PR649, with unchanged rank mass 520,704, deficit 2,560, and physical stock 7,670.

An independent checker derives literal controller windows, all 35,424 placements and actual 73-column charts. The accompanying discrete concavity proof establishes strict complex-moment improvement over both PR645 and PR649 for every exponent in `(0,1)`. The search is not part of admission, and no global optimality is claimed.

The package supplies explicit owners, exact certificates, independent audits, an optional optimizer, immutable dependencies and reproduction instructions. The physical checking programs remain byte-identical to PR645; the disclosed assembly adapter selects and pins PR589. A Python 3.11/3.14 CI workflow runs the complete source rebuild.

## Validation

- Fresh Gauge44 scalar/native/dual, wrapper and phase reconstruction from pinned PR635/PR645 sources; independent scalar audit passes.
- Final packaged replay using that rebuilt local provider passes owner audits, complete physical admission, finite invoice, two rational moment engines, all 47 strict outer constraints and independent pricing.
- All 69 assembly admission controls and six independent owner mutation controls reject; optimized execution and an incorrect seed input are rejected.
- Package inventory and uploaded Git blobs are checked against local hashes.
- Repository-wide `make verify` passed all groups through `gen4-bank-verify`, then stopped in the unchanged `frontier626-verify` dependency: [`research/e8-bit-r420/verify.sh:40`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/17ce0c79b7b51c2634b439ea5a2b754f09909693/research/e8-bit-r420/verify.sh#L40) leaves `$C/provenance.py` unquoted and splits a checkout path containing a space. This script, its caller and Makefile are byte-identical to the base; subsequent groups were not run. The new package replay above passed independently.
- Six GitHub workflows await maintainer approval; remote CI is not claimed passed.

## Sources and scope

PR649 is pinned at `1b931ee055d738753778e1051300140c16ae219d`; PR645 at `638a5171dd1aca89ff50d07dcbe288b567769804`. The README pins the complete dependency chain and records reproducible commands.

Credit to **jeremykothe2** for PR649's dissolved seed and existing PR589 composition; **icekylinx** for PR645's Gauge44 construction; **DreamingOfClouds**, **eumemic** and the credited PR589 lineage for the bit supplier; **vectorsss / Chi Zhao** for the PR638 relocation lineage; and the retained PR635/controller/invoice contributors. Prepared for Jay Mosley with substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance; predecessor AI assistance and original notices remain acknowledged.

This is a conditional finite witness. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic-transfer and bit-supplier assumptions remain. The bit profile is freshly repriced, but its circuit is cited unchanged rather than independently rebuilt here. No unconditional theorem or complete Lean proof is claimed. **The original κ ≥ 2^-8 target is not reached.**
